response.justification: Bogdan has strong engineering leadership experience and relevant technical skills in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and real-time data processing, as demonstrated by his roles at Dunnhumby and Optilyz. His work on the GISCollective platform shows expertise in scalable, event-driven systems. However, his experience with AI-agent infrastructure is limited to recent work at re:cinq, and lacks direct production experience with multi-agent systems in fintech or regulated environments. His background is more aligned with general software engineering than the specialized agentic-AI and fintech requirements for this role.
strengths: Strong distributed-systems expertise with event-driven architectures (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby)
Proven engineering leadership in scaling teams and improving engineering practices (e.g., Altom, Optilyz)
Hands-on experience with real-time systems and low-latency applications (e.g., Dunnhumby, WatchUp)
concerns: Limited production experience with multi-agent AI systems in fintech or regulated environments
No direct experience with fintech infrastructure (credit systems, payment flows, embedded finance)
Recent AI-agent work may not yet demonstrate full architectural depth for a CTO role
